title: Codex Skill injection presence snapshot
description: Privacy-bounded allowlisted Codex Skill injection presence from valid, recorded, strictly positive counter datapoints observed during one collector lifetime.

injectedSkills.description: Sorted, deduplicated exact caller-allowlisted Skill labels observed in valid, recorded, strictly positive counter datapoints with exact status=ok.

items.$comment: The 256-Unicode-scalar limit bounds a well-formed string to at most 1024 UTF-8 bytes; the implementation validates both limits.

unrecognizedSkillObserved.description: True only when an otherwise valid, recorded, strictly positive exact status=ok counter datapoint contained a Skill string outside the caller allowlist; that string is not retained.
